items.title: maintenanceNov 20, 2026[Completed] Unscheduled Quanah World Channel Maintenance - November 20, 2026The channel maintenance has been completed. Thank you for your patience.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Nov 20, 2026
[COMPLETED] UNSCHEDULED QUANAH WORLD CHANNEL MAINTENANCE - NOVEMBER 20, 2026

[Updated 11/20 at 6:20 PM PST] The channel maintenance has been completed. Thank you for your patience.

We will be performing an unscheduled channel maintenance for Event World: Quanah today, Friday, November 20, 2026 at 5:00 PM PST (8:00 PM EST / 2:00 AM CET November 21 / 12:00 PM AEDT November 21). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 2 hours, concluding around 7:00 PM PST (10:00 PM EST / 4:00 AM CET November 21 / 2:00 PM AEDT November 21).

Times:

Friday, November 20, 2026
PST (UTC -8): 5:00 PM - 7:00 PM
EST (UTC -5): 8:00 PM - 10:00 PM
CET (UTC +1): 2:00 AM November 21 - 4:00 AM November 21
AEDT (UTC +11): 12:00 PM November 21 - 2:00 PM November 21

What will be unavailable:

Group A
Channels 1 - 30 on NA Quanah.
Channels 1 - 5 on EU Quanah.
Group B
Channels 31 - 60 on NA Quanah.
Channels 6 - 10 on EU Quanah.

Changes and Updates:

Resolved an issue where Quanah Unlimited Elixir’s actual cooldown did not match its listed 9-second cooldown, which caused both the Auto HP Potion pet skill and manual use to fail inconsistently.

items.title: maintenanceNov 19, 2026[Completed] Scheduled Minor Patch - November 19, 2026The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 7 hours.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Nov 19, 2026
[COMPLETED] SCHEDULED MINOR PATCH - NOVEMBER 19, 2026

[Updated 11/19 at 12:00 PM PST] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 7 hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to ensure you receive the latest client update.

We will be performing a scheduled minor patch starting on Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 5:00 AM PST (8:00 AM EST / 2:00 PM CET / 12:00 AM AEDT November 20). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 8 hours, concluding around 1:00 PM PST (4:00 PM EST / 10:00 PM CET / 8:00 AM AEDT November 20).

Times:

Thursday, November 19, 2026
PST (UTC -8): 5:00 AM - 1:00 PM
EST (UTC -5): 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM
CET (UTC +1): 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM
AEDT (UTC +11): 12:00 AM - 8:00 AM November 20

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory game servers.
MapleStory Classic World will not be affected.

Changes and Updates:

MapleStory will be updated to v.272.3.0.
Monthly Windows Update.
Sol Erda Fragments dropped in the Geardock region of Interactive worlds have been changed from tradable within account to tradable.
Resolved an issue where the Hyper Blink Beauty Salon quest could not be completed for some Burning characters.
Resolved an issue where Sia Astelle’s Legion member bonus for Abnormal Status Damage was not being applied to Additional Status Damage.
Resolved an issue where Ren characters in Challenger Worlds could get stuck on the pre-quest dialogue and be unable to start the Ursus boss fight.
Resolved an issue where rolling the dice in Mystic Frontier could cause the client to close for some players.
Resolved an issue where players in the Netherlands were unable to drop quest and boss items, such as the Eye of Fire needed to summon Zakum.
Resolved an issue where the Maple Planner did not show quest progress for Erda’s Request.
Resolved an issue where part of Ren’s HEXA Final Imugi Spirit Sword: Burrowing Earth effect stayed visible to party members in boss fights, even with Effect Transparency for Other Characters set to 0.
Resolved an issue where defeating Chaos Pink Bean did not count toward the Daily Boss mission for Auto-Harvest.
Resolved an issue where trace restoration missions were not working as intended.
Resolved an issue where Lethe characters who opened the 15-Star Epic Fafnir Weapon Box (Time-Restricted) from the Hyper Burning MAX reward received a Fafnir Edict with Attack Power potential instead of Magic ATT.
Any claimed Fafnir Edicts will automatically be updated to Magic ATT.
Resolved an issue where Zero’s Transcendent tooltip had overlapping text.
Resolved an issue where the recommission text in the Custom Portrait Shop displayed incorrectly.
Resolved an issue with the Extra Storage Selector Coupon and High Quality Bag Selector Coupon from the Operation Ultima Meso Shop.
Both coupons can be used again.
The following bags, which were temporarily disabled, can now be used again:
80-Slot Android Bag
80-Slot Medal Bag
40-Slot Trait Bag
40-Slot Symbol Coupon Bag
40-Slot Boss Loot Bag
60-Slot Mineral Bag
60-Slot Herb Bag
60-Slot Production Bag
Resolved an issue where non-Mechanic Resistance characters, such as Battle Mage, automatically learned the Mechanic skill Jet Booster after a Quanah World Leap.
Resolved an issue where the Operation Ultima Bounty Coin Shop was missing items in EU Challenger-Interactive worlds.
Resolved a text issue where “(null)” appeared in the error message when Mo Xuan characters tried to equip a Red Whip.
Resolved a text issue where the “Giant upon Fattening Up” option in the Pet section of the Effect Settings menu was labeled as “Enrage upon Fattening Up”.
Genesis Pass
An additional Arcane Force buff effect has been applied to the Genesis Pass.
The sales period for the Genesis Pass has been extended by one week.
February 8, 2027 11:59 PM UTC → February 15, 2027 11:59 PM UTC.
The Genesis Pass use and effect period has been extended by one week.
February 9, 2027 11:59 PM UTC → February 16, 2027 11:59 PM UTC.

Quanah World Changes and Updates:

General
Quanah’s Dimensional Skill damage has been reduced by 30%.
Adjusted item drop rate for Quanah Crystals and Mapae Fragments in Quanah World.
In extremely rare cases, Mapae Badges were issued as duplicates. The duplicates have been removed, and only the badge with the highest enhancement level was kept.
Resolved an issue where some Quanah quests did not give the correct number of Jewels and Medals.
Following this maintenance, the missing rewards have been distributed to affected players.
Resolved an issue where Hologram equipment dropped in Quanah World could be restored.
Resolved an issue where Hologram equipment dropped in Quanah World could be extracted in the Profession UI.
Resolved an issue where some of Quanah’s Dimensional Skill descriptions listed the cooldown as 240 seconds instead of 180 seconds.
Resolved an issue where the [Hologram] Worldreaver Effect transparency was not applied correctly.
Resolved an issue where using the [Hologram] Cannon Barrage skill would sometimes cause the client to disconnect when activated in environments with high network latency.
Resolved an issue where Shadower’s Steal skill did not drop potions when defeating enemies in the Proving Fields.
Resolved a text issue where the Quanah's Dimensional Skill listed the incorrect end date for Quanah World.
Resolved a text issue where Quanah was spelled “Qunnah” on the World Map in Quanah World.
Resolved a text issue where untranslated text appeared in the quest “Someone Lost a Pocket.”
Quanah Maple Point Shop
New items have been added to the Quanah Maple Point Shop.
Holo Lil Kroma Pet Coupon
Price: 25,000 Maple Points
Purchase limit: 2
Use to receive the following:
Holo Lil Kroma Pet: Untradable.
5 Sol Erda: Untradable.
Althea’s Item Support
Added a new Item Support menu to Althea in the Quanah World Plaza. Talk to her to claim support items.
Claim period: Until March 9, 2027 at 11:59 PM UTC.
Rewards:
Healing Tree Infirmary Coupon x3
3x EXP Coupon (30 min) x5
Sol Erda x3
Proving Fields
Increased the EXP earned from defeating enemies in the Proving Fields hunting grounds.
Basic: EXP increased by 30%.
Intermediate: EXP increased by 15%.
Advanced: EXP increased by 10%.
Increased the HP and damage of enemies in the Intermediate and Advanced Hunting Grounds of the Proving Fields.
Intermediate: HP increased by 20%.
Advanced: HP increased by 30%.
Attacks from enemies in the Intermediate and Advanced Hunting Grounds now deal damage based on a percentage of your character’s Max HP.
Resolved an issue where instanced equipment drops in the Proving Fields were based on party members’ classes instead of your own class.
Infinite Dungeon: Battlesim
The dungeon inventory has been expanded from 240 → 400 slots.
The Infinite Dungeon: Battlesim inventory can now also be accessed through Libae in Libae’s Laboratory.
Fatigue no longer recovers when moving between floors.
Elite Survival floors are now cleared immediately once all monsters are defeated.
Increased the visible area of the Limited Vision stage effect.
Pets can now pick up Recovery Marbles dropped in Infinite Dungeon: Battlesim.
Strangler Fig Pattern Program effect changed from 20%/40%/60% → 10%/20%/30%.
The Debuggy Program now grants 2 seconds of invincibility upon revival.
Resolved an issue where the Entropy Program’s Final Damage effect was not applying correctly.
Resolved an issue where the Final Damage value was not displayed in the Reset button’s description.
Resolved an issue where the attack range of the 10th floor boss, Snack Bar, was not applied correctly.
Resolved an issue where the Skill Hotkey assignment guide text in the Battlesim UI would run off the screen on first entry.

items.title: maintenanceNov 19, 2026v.272 Known IssuesHere you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.272 - Maplayer One update.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Nov 19, 2026
V.272 KNOWN ISSUES

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.272 - Maplayer One update:

KNOWN ISSUES:
RESOLVED ISSUES:

November 19, 2026

Resolved an issue with the Extra Storage Selector Coupon and High Quality Bag Selector Coupon from the Operation Ultima Meso Shop.
Both coupons can be used again.
The following bags, which were temporarily disabled, can now be used again:
80-Slot Android Bag
80-Slot Medal Bag
40-Slot Trait Bag
40-Slot Symbol Coupon Bag
40-Slot Boss Loot Bag
60-Slot Mineral Bag
60-Slot Herb Bag
60-Slot Production Bag
Resolved an issue where trace restoration missions were not working as intended.
An additional Arcane Force buff effect has been applied to the Genesis Pass.
The sales period for the Genesis Pass has been extended by one week.
February 8, 2027 11:59 PM UTC → February 15, 2027 11:59 PM UTC.
The Genesis Pass use and effect period has been extended by one week.
February 9, 2027 11:59 PM UTC → February 16, 2027 11:59 PM UTC.

November 17, 2026

Resolved an issue where the Inspector’s Mapae could not be received again if the Inspector’s Mapae Trace was in the inventory.

November 13, 2026

Resolved an issue where some Mo Xuan characters were unable to proceed through Hyper Blink due to having extra Skill Points (SP).
Resolved an issue where newly created Luminous characters would get stuck in the intro cutscene after choosing Light or Dark.
Resolved an issue where characters would be unable to leave the map after completing the 6th Job Erda Link tutorial or the HEXA Matrix tutorial.
Resolved an issue where the Auto Harvest was not visible in the Event List for some characters.
Resolved an issue where some quests in Quanah World may have awarded less Special Medals of Honor and Jewel items than intended.
Any unclaimed rewards will automatically be distributed to the affected characters during the next scheduled maintenance.

November 12, 2026

Sol Erda Fragment drops in Quanah have been adjusted.
Sol Erda Fragments dropped in dungeons have been slightly decreased.
Sol Erda Fragments obtained by defeating monsters in the Proving Field have been slightly increased.
Resolved an issue where certain classes in transformation or riding states were unable to use Quanah World Skills.
Resolved an issue where some characters were unable to log in after using items from their Consumables inventory, such as Symbol Coupons, boss loot, or stat-boosting items.
In rare cases, items in the Consumables inventory may have disappeared. These items will be fully restored for all affected players during the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, November 19.
As previously announced, certain items, including Other Slot Selection Coupons, Premium Bag Selection Coupons, and specific items in the Consumables inventory, will become usable after the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, November 19.
Resolved an issue where players could accept more Quanah-exclusive quests than intended.
Characters with 5 quests in progress will have the quests in slots 3, 4, and 5 removed. Only the quests in slots 1 and 2 will remain.
Resolved an issue where the game client for Phantom characters would disconnect when opening the Skill window.

November 11, 2026

Resolved an issue where Sol Erda Energy obtained from certain sources could not be used by some characters Lv. 290 and above once they had 20 Sol Erda.
Resolved an issue where the Beyond Burning event was not visible in the Event List for some characters.
Resolved an issue where characters designated for Quanah World Leap were unable to World Leap to Quanah after claiming the Maplayer One video rewards.
items.bodyZh: 维护公告 2026年11月19日 V.272 已知问题 已知问题部分主要聚焦于对游戏及社区造成重大影响、且我们团队正在积极处理的主要问题。请注意，尽管我们力求涵盖影响最大的问题，但此列表不会包含所有已报告的问题。请定期查看，以获取这些问题的最新状态、已解决问题信息，或可能新增的任何新问题。 以下为 v.272 - 次元之境：一拳超人 更新中的已知问题与已解决问题列表： 已知问题： 已解决问题： 2026年11月19日 修复了终极行动金币商店中额外仓库选择券与高品质背包选择券的问题。 两种选择券均可再次使用。 以下暂时禁用的背包现已可再次使用： 80格机器人背包 80格勋章背包 40格特性背包 40格符号选择券背包 40格首领战利品背包 60格矿物背包 60格草药背包 60格制作背包 修复了痕迹恢复任务未按预期生效的问题。 创世通行证新增了额外的神秘力量增益效果。 创世通行证销售期延长一周。 2027年2月8日 晚上11:59 UTC（北京时间 2027年2月9日 上午7:59）→ 2027年2月15日 晚上11:59 UTC（北京时间 2027年2月16日 上午7:59）。 创世通行证使用及效果期延长一周。 2027年2月9日 晚上11:59 UTC（北京时间 2027年2月10日 上午7:59）→ 2027年2月16日 晚上11:59 UTC（北京时间 2027年2月17日 上午7:59）。 2026年11月17日 修复了当背包中持有监察官的马牌痕迹时，无法再次获得监察官的马牌的问题。 2026年11月13日 修复了部分墨玄角色因拥有额外技能点（SP）而无法进行超级闪现的问题。 修复了新建的夜光角色在选择光或暗后卡在开场动画中的问题。 修复了角色在完成第六次转职艾尔达链接教程或HEXA矩阵教程后无法离开地图的问题。 修复了部分角色的自动采集未在活动列表中显示的问题。 修复了夸纳世界中部分任务可能奖励少于预期的特殊荣誉勋章和宝石物品的问题。 任何未领取的奖励将在下次预定维护期间自动发放给受影响角色。 2026年11月12日 调整了夸纳中索尔艾尔达碎片的掉落。 地牢中掉落的索尔艾尔达碎片略微减少。 在试炼场中击败怪物获得的索尔艾尔达碎片略微增加。 修复了某些职业在变身或骑乘状态下无法使用夸纳世界技能的问题。 修复了部分角色在使用消耗品背包中的物品（如符号选择券、首领战利品或属性增益物品）后无法登录的问题。 在极少数情况下，消耗品背包中的物品可能已消失。这些物品将在2026年11月19日（星期四）的预定维护期间为所有受影响玩家全额恢复。 如先前公告所述，包括其他栏位选择券、高级背包选择券以及消耗品背包中的特定物品在内的某些物品，将在2026年11月19日（星期四）的预定维护后变为可用。 修复了玩家可以接受超过预期数量的夸纳专属任务的问题。 进行中任务为5个的角色将移除第3、4、5栏位的任务。仅保留第1、2栏位的任务。 修复了幻影角色在打开技能窗口时游戏客户端会断开连接的问题。 2026年11月11日 修复了部分290级及以上角色在拥有20个索尔艾尔达后，无法使用从特定来源获得的索尔艾尔达能量的问题。 修复了部分角色的超越燃烧活动未在活动列表中显示的问题。 修复了被指定进行夸纳世界飞跃的角色在领取次元之境：一拳超人视频奖励后无法世界飞跃至夸纳的问题。
